combo_label: London Underground × Ice Skating × The Blitz

entries.clue: Device whose rising and falling wail sent a street down to the shelters
Initials of the world body that has governed the sport since 1892
Full-turn jump landing on a back inside edge, a link between two others
Northern line stop beside a famous Kennington cricket ground
Humber port, named in reports only as a north-east town, where most houses were hit
Strip of hollow-ground steel between boot sole and the ice
Yellow line that, despite the name, now runs as a spiral to Hammersmith
Flow of electricity, drawn on the Underground from rails, not overhead wires
Child sent from a city to the country with a case and a luggage label
Civil defence officer who chased stray light and reported incidents
City station whose name recalls an old gate onto marshy ground
Pulse-jet flying bomb of 1944 whose engine cut out before the dive
Set dance whose prescribed sequence is repeated lap after lap of the ice
